script: There is a giant, nearly empty region of space called the Bootes Void. It is about 330 million light-years across. It holds far fewer galaxies than a region that size normally would. If we lived in its center, we would not have known other galaxies existed until the 1960s. Voids like this sit between long strands of galaxies, like a giant cosmic web.
